archetype: Premium Soft Utility (Blend of Swiss High-Contrast & Pastel Softness)
rationale: A Belgian property management SaaS requires deep trust and clarity (Archetype 4), but to make it visually 'sexy' and modern as requested, we infuse rounded geometries, soft drop shadows, and subtle micro-interactions from Archetype 3. This reduces cognitive load on dense data like PCMN accounting, while feeling premium.

typography.guidelines: Never use Inter for headings. Keep letter-spacing tight for headings to ensure a premium look. Use Plus Jakarta Sans for its excellent readability in data-heavy accounting tables.

top_nav.layout: Sticky horizontal top bar. Flex container with logo left, navigation center, user/ACP selector right.
top_nav.active_state: Include a subtle dot indicator under or next to the active link matching the section color.
top_nav.dropdowns: Sub-menus use rounded-2xl dropdowns with soft drop shadows and section-colored hover states on items.

kpi_widgets.style: Cards with rounded-2xl, p-6, pure white bg, soft shadow.
kpi_widgets.icons: Wrapped in a rounded-full container (w-12 h-12) flex items-center justify-center with a light tinted background of the section color (e.g., bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-500).
kpi_widgets.trends: Subtle badges rounded-full flex items-center gap-1 (e.g., text-xs font-medium text-emerald-600 bg-emerald-50 px-2 py-1)

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white rounded-xl px-5 py-2.5 font-medium hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-lg hover:shadow-primary/25 transition-all duration-200
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-slate-700 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl px-5 py-2.5 font-medium hover:bg-slate-50 transition-all duration-200
buttons.ghost: text-slate-600 rounded-xl px-4 py-2 hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-900 transition-colors

modals_dialogs.header: border-b border-slate-100 px-6 py-4 flex justify-between items-center bg-slate-50/50
modals_dialogs.footer: border-t border-slate-100 px-6 py-4 flex justify-end gap-3 bg-slate-50/50

tables.header: bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-200 text-slate-500 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider

login_page.layout: 2-column grid (1fr 1fr). Left side is form centered, right side is the premium marble image covering full height.
login_page.form_side: bg-slate-50 flex flex-col justify-center items-center p-12 min-h-screen
login_page.form_card: w-full max-w-md bg-white p-8 rounded-3xl shadow-card
login_page.image_overlay: absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-br from-primary/20 to-slate-900/40 mix-blend-multiply

interactions_and_animations.hover: All interactive elements MUST have a state change. Cards slightly lift (-translate-y-1) and increase shadow. Rows get a subtle background tint.
interactions_and_animations.page_transitions: Fade-in for main content area to avoid harsh jumps between sections.
interactions_and_animations.modals: Scale-up entrance (95% to 100%) and fade-in for dialogs.
interactions_and_animations.data_testids: Ensure every interactive component preserves or adds data-testid in kebab-case for automated testing constraints.

login_marble_bg.description: Modern minimalist gray marble abstract painting. To be used as the right-column hero background on the login page.
login_marble_bg.usage: bg-cover bg-center object-cover w-full h-full absolute inset-0

instructions_to_main_agent: Replace 'Chivo' and 'Inter' imports with 'Outfit' (Headings) and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' (Body).
Update tailwind.config.js to include the new primary blue (#2563EB) and section colors.
Refactor TopNav to use backdrop-blur-xl and the updated colored dot indicators.
Refine all Shadcn Card components to use 'rounded-2xl' and the new custom soft shadows.
Refine Shadcn Button primitives to use 'rounded-xl' and add subtle hover transform (-translate-y-0.5).
Update Shadcn Dialog to use 'rounded-3xl' and customize header/footer background tints.
Implement the 2-column login layout utilizing the provided marble image URL.
Ensure all data-testid attributes are preserved strictly during component restructuring.
